## S1: Lysis Conditions
### B: Microbial taxonomic profiling across lysis conditions
#### Four-species mock community (Fig. S1.1)
```{r mock_RMSE_calculation, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
# Select samples & close composition
mock_wide <- tidy_plot_genome_counts_filt_30_mock_closed %>%
  filter(culture == "MX") %>%
  select(genome, microsample, count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = genome,values_from = count,values_fill = 0) %>%
  select(where(~ any(. != 0)) | where(is.character) | where(is.factor)) %>%   
  column_to_rownames(var = "microsample") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . / rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))) * 100))

# Transform genome counts to CLR relative abundance values
mock_wide_CLR <- as.data.frame(t(apply(mock_wide, 1, clr_transform))) 

# Pivot df to tidy for plotting
mock_wide_CLR_tidy <- mock_wide_CLR %>%
  # Convert row names into a column
  rownames_to_column(var = "microsample") %>%  
  # Convert all other columns (microbes) into long format
  pivot_longer(cols = -microsample,  
               names_to = "genome", 
               values_to = "relabun") %>%
  left_join(genome_metadata_mock, by = join_by(genome == genome)) %>% 
  left_join(sample_metadata_mock, by = join_by(microsample == sample)) %>%
  select(-LabBatch_text, -culture) %>%
  # Set expected CLR value for all genomes
  mutate(expected = 0) %>% # not really needed, obviously, but for consistency
  mutate(error = relabun - expected) 
  
mock_RMSE_df <- mock_wide_CLR_tidy %>%
  group_by(genome, buffer) %>% 
  summarise(
    # Root Mean Squared Error across samples for each taxon for each buffer
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    span = (max(relabun, na.rm = TRUE) - min(relabun, na.rm = TRUE)), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

mock_RMSE_df %>%
  group_by(buffer) %>%
  summarise(median_RMSE = median(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  knitr::kable(align = "lccc")
```



#### Microsamples (caecum and colon)

##### Sequencing Performance (Fig. S1.2)
```{r fig_s1_2_plot,  echo=TRUE, warning = FALSE, comments = "", message = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
s1_microsample_df <- macroquant_metrics_filt_30 %>%
  filter(
    batch %in% c("MSEB0006", "MSEB0010"), # Caeucum (MSEB0006) and Colon (MSEB0010)
    section %in% c("Caecum right", "Colon"),
    cycles %in% c(13, 14, 15),
    type %in% c("positive"),
    richness > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    collection_attempts = as.factor(collection_attempts),
    buffer = as.factor(buffer)
  )
# something wrong duplication rate
ordered_metrics <- c(
  "total_after_filtering.total_reads",
  "mapmag_prokreads_pct",
  #"duplication.rate",
  "richness",
  "neutral",
  "phylogenetic"
)

fig_s1_2 <- s1_microsample_df %>%
  mutate(
    mapmag_prokreads_pct = mapmag_prokreads_pct * 100 ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(names(mssm_sample_metadata), "cov_filtering"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(metric %in% ordered_metrics) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = ordered_metrics),
    metric = fct_recode(metric,
      "a. Sequencing Yield \nPost-Quality Filtering" = "total_after_filtering.total_reads",
      "b. Reads Mapping \nMAG Catalogue (%)" = "mapmag_prokreads_pct",
      #"c. Reads \nDuplication Rate (%)" = "duplication.rate",
      "d. Richness" = "richness",
      "e. Neutral" = "neutral",
      "f. Phylogenetic" = "phylogenetic"
    ),
    section = recode(section,

      "Colon" = "Colon"
    )

  ggplot(aes(x = section, y = value, fill = buffer)) +

  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +

    fill = "Lysis",
    y = "",
    x = "Intestinal section"
  ) +
  # geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(0.8), na.rm = TRUE) +  # Violin plot

    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.8),

  ) +

  custom_ggplot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig_s1_2 

```
No clear performance advantage was observed between methods L06 and L07 in caecum microsamples. Although L06 was initially selected, a subsequent experiment suggested that L07 may offer enhanced lysis performance in colon microsamples.

## S2: Resource optimisation
### Summary Statistic
```{r s2_stat,  echo=TRUE, warning = FALSE, comments = "", message = FALSE}
s2_df <- macroquant_metrics_filt_30 %>%
  filter(
    batch %in% c("MSEB0009", "MSEB0014", "MSEB0015"),
    type %in% c("positive"),
    size %in% c("5000"),
    !between(as.numeric(sub("M", "", microsample)), 300651, 300665)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    protocol = ifelse(protocol %in% c("ULV2_Full"), "100%", "50%"),
    comparison = ifelse(batch %in% c("MSEB0009"), "Cost", "Throughput"),
    lib_method = ifelse(batch %in% c("MSEB0015"), "Automation (1 plate set-up)", "Manual"),
    comparison_grid = ifelse(comparison == "Cost", protocol, lib_method)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = as.factor(comparison),
    comparison_grid = as.factor(comparison_grid)
  ) # %>% count(comparison, batch)

s2_stat <- s2_df %>%
  mutate(
    other = total_before_filtering.total_reads -
      (
        (total_before_filtering.total_reads - total_after_filtering.total_reads) +
        reads_mapped_chicken +
        reads_mapped_human +
        reads_mapped_pig +
        reads_mapped_mag +
        reads_unmapped_mag
      ),
    low_quality_reads = total_before_filtering.total_reads - total_after_filtering.total_reads
  ) %>%
  select(
    microsample,
    comparison_grid,
    total_before_filtering.total_reads,
    low_quality_reads,
    reads_mapped_chicken,
    reads_mapped_human,
    reads_mapped_pig,
    reads_mapped_mag,
    reads_unmapped_mag,
    other
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(microsample, comparison_grid, total_before_filtering.total_reads),
      ~ (. / total_before_filtering.total_reads) * 100,
      .names = "{.col}_pct"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(microsample, comparison_grid, ends_with("_pct")) %>%
  group_by(comparison_grid) %>%
  summarise(
    low_quality_reads = format_median_iqr(low_quality_reads_pct),
    mapping_chicken   = format_median_iqr(reads_mapped_chicken_pct),
    mapping_human     = format_median_iqr(reads_mapped_human_pct),
    mapping_pig       = format_median_iqr(reads_mapped_pig_pct),
    mapping_bacteria  = format_median_iqr(reads_mapped_mag_pct),
    unmapped_bacteria = format_median_iqr(reads_unmapped_mag_pct),
    other             = format_median_iqr(other_pct),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("comparison_grid") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()

knitr::kable(
  s2_stat,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = "lccc",
  caption = "Median percentage (IQR) of reads in each processing category"
)
```

### Library Preparation Efficiency (Fig. S2.1b)

```{r fig_s2_1b,  echo=TRUE, warning = FALSE, comments = "", message = FALSE}
s2_dreamprep_df <- sn3_5_dreamprep_df %>%
  mutate(plate = str_extract(sample, "^Plate \\d+")) %>%
  filter(
    !Range %in% c("35 bp to 100 bp"),
    concentration %in% c("0.1"),

  ) %>%

    plate = case_when(

    Range = case_when(
      grepl("100 bp to 200 bp", Range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Non-specific Short Fragments",
      grepl("200 bp to 1000 bp", Range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Library",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
```

## S6
### Sequencing depth in the equivolume batches (MSEB0060-75)

#### Panel a: Nonpareil coverage
```{r fig_nonpareil, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, comments = "", message = FALSE}
# Nonpareil counts read pairs after QC and host removal (1 read pair = 2 reads).
equivolume_batches <- c("MSEB0060", "MSEB0061", paste0("MSEB00", 68:75))
section_colors <- c("Caecum right" = "#c1558b", "Colon" = "#ffc273")
animal_shapes <- c("G121e" = 16, "G103b" = 18)            # circle, diamond
animal_lines  <- c("G121e" = "solid", "G103b" = "dotted")
reads_per_pair <- 2

# Same depth (x) axis in all three figures, so they line up in a composite figure
depth_scale <- scale_x_log10(limits = c(1e4, 3e8), breaks = 10^(4:8),
                             labels = c("0.01M", "0.1M", "1M", "10M", "100M"))
depth_label <- "Reads for bacterial quantification (log10)"

depth_df <- macroquant_metrics_filt_30 %>%
  filter(batch %in% equivolume_batches, type == "positive") %>%
  mutate(group = paste(animal, ifelse(section == "Colon", "colon", "caecum"))) # animal + section: one smooth curve per group in panel c

# Full Nonpareil subsampling curves of every sample (retained and excluded microsamples), from 01-data_preparation
np_raw <- mssm_nonpareil_curves %>%
  inner_join(depth_df %>% select(microsample, section, animal, cov_filtering), by = "microsample")

as_vec <- function(s) as.numeric(str_split_1(str_remove_all(s, "\\[|\\]"), ", ")) # "[0, 2, ...]" -> numbers

# Curves: one row per subsampling point (effort in Mbp / read length = million read pairs)
np_obs <- np_raw %>%
  transmute(microsample, section, animal, L = as.numeric(nonpareil_L),
            mreads = purrr::map(nonpareil_x.adj, as_vec), coverage = purrr::map(nonpareil_y.cov, as_vec)) %>%
  unnest(c(mreads, coverage)) %>%
  mutate(mreads = mreads / L, coverage = coverage / 100) %>%
  filter(mreads >= 0.01)                                   # drop the 0-read starting point (log axis)

# End point of each curve = the sample's real depth and coverage
np_sample <- np_raw %>%
  transmute(microsample, section, animal, cov_filtering,
            mreads = as.numeric(nonpareil_R) / 1e6, coverage = as.numeric(nonpareil_C))

# Depth at which a curve first reaches a coverage threshold (interpolated on log depth; NA = never reached)
first_cross <- function(mreads, coverage, thr) {
  i <- which(coverage >= thr)[1]
  if (is.na(i)) return(NA_real_)
  if (i == 1) return(mreads[1])
  10^approx(coverage[(i - 1):i], log10(mreads[(i - 1):i]), xout = thr, ties = mean)$y
}

np_cross_samples <- np_obs %>%
  arrange(microsample, mreads) %>%
  group_by(microsample) %>%
  summarise(`0.90` = first_cross(mreads, coverage, 0.90), `0.95` = first_cross(mreads, coverage, 0.95)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-microsample, names_to = "threshold", values_to = "pairs_needed") %>%
  mutate(threshold = as.numeric(threshold))

# Microsamples reaching 90% / 95% coverage and median read pairs needed
np_cross <- np_cross_samples %>%
  group_by(threshold) %>%
  summarise(n_reached = sum(!is.na(pairs_needed)), n = n(),
            median_pairs = median(pairs_needed, na.rm = TRUE))

# The 90% / 95% coverage lines, reused in the next two figures as depth lines (median reads needed)
cov_lines <- np_cross %>%
  mutate(reads = median_pairs * 1e6 * reads_per_pair,   # read pairs (M) -> reads
         line  = ifelse(threshold == 0.90, "dotdash", "dashed"),
         label = paste0(100 * threshold, "% coverage"))

# Plotted in reads (not read pairs), to share the x axis with the other two figures
to_reads <- function(m_pairs) m_pairs * 1e6 * reads_per_pair   # million read pairs -> reads

fig_nonpareil <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cov_lines$threshold, linetype = cov_lines$line, colour = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.2e4, y = cov_lines$threshold, label = cov_lines$label,
           hjust = 0, vjust = c(1.4, -0.5), size = 3, colour = "grey30") +   # 90% below its line, 95% above
  geom_line(data = np_obs, aes(to_reads(mreads), coverage, group = microsample, colour = section, linetype = animal),
            alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = np_sample, aes(to_reads(mreads), coverage, colour = section, shape = animal), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(np_sample, cov_filtering == "Excluded By Filtering"), # x over excluded samples (as in b)
             aes(to_reads(mreads), coverage), shape = 4, size = 0.5, stroke = 0.7, colour = "grey15") +
  geom_boxplot(data = filter(np_cross_samples, !is.na(pairs_needed)),
               aes(x = to_reads(pairs_needed), y = threshold, group = threshold), orientation = "y",
               width = 0.025, colour = "grey15", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4,
               outlier.size = 0.6, outlier.colour = "grey15") +
  depth_scale +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = section_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = animal_shapes, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = animal_lines, name = NULL) +
  guides(colour   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),     # readable keys
         shape    = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),
         linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.6))) +
  labs(x = depth_label, y = "Nonpareil coverage") +
  custom_ggplot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

#### Panel b: Reads per batch
```{r fig_reads_per_batch_equivolume, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, comments = "", message = FALSE}
set.seed(1)
reads_eq_df <- depth_df %>%
  mutate(batch = gsub("MSEB00", "B", batch),
         batch = factor(batch, levels = rev(sort(unique(batch)))),  # reversed, so B60 is at the top
         batch_jit = as.numeric(batch) + runif(n(), -0.2, 0.2))      # jitter once, so the x's land on their own points

fig_reads_per_batch <- ggplot(reads_eq_df, aes(x = raw_total_sequences_mag)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = batch), fill = NA, outlier.shape = NA) +   # transparent box, points drawn below

             aes(y = batch_jit), shape = 4, size = 0.5, stroke = 0.7, colour = "grey15") +
```

#### Panel c: Richness vs reads
```{r fig_richness_vs_reads, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, comments = "", message = FALSE}
# Retained microsamples only: excluded microsamples have richness 0 by definition.
richness_df <- depth_df %>% filter(cov_filtering == "Retained By Filtering")

fig_richness_vs_reads <- ggplot(richness_df, aes(x = raw_total_sequences_mag, y = richness, colour = section)) +
  # Median reads needed for 90% / 95% Nonpareil coverage (cov_lines from fig_nonpareil)
  geom_vline(xintercept = cov_lines$reads, linetype = cov_lines$line, colour = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = cov_lines$reads, y = 5, label = cov_lines$label, angle = 90,
           hjust = 0, vjust = c(-0.5, 1.4), size = 3, colour = "grey30") +   # 90% left of its line, 95% right
  geom_point(aes(shape = animal), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  # GAM (k = 4), one curve per animal + section
  geom_smooth(aes(fill = section, linetype = animal, group = group), method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 4),
              se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  depth_scale +
  scale_colour_manual(values = section_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = section_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = animal_shapes, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = animal_lines, name = NULL) +
  guides(shape    = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),     # readable keys, grey line keys
         linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = "grey30", fill = NA))) +
  labs(x = depth_label, y = "Richness") +
  custom_ggplot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Image darkness vs microbial reads (S6)
```{r s6_darkness_data, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
original_image <- function(cryo) file.path(pixel_coords_dir, "original", paste0(cryo, ".png"))

darkness_samples <- macroquant_metrics_filt_30 %>%
  filter(type == "positive", batch %in% sprintf("MSEB%04d", 60:75), collection == "Success") %>%
  transmute(microsample, cryosection, section, animal, batch, Xcoord, Ycoord,
            size = as.numeric(as.character(size)),          # stored as a factor
            reads = raw_total_sequences_mag) %>%
  inner_join(read_csv(file.path(pixel_coords_dir, "microsample_pixel_coords_airtable.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
               select(microsample, pixel_x, pixel_y),
             by = "microsample") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pixel_x), !is.na(size), file.exists(original_image(cryosection)))

# 255 - mean grey value of the image pixels inside a circle (grey: rows = y, columns = x)
spot_darkness <- function(grey, x, y, r) {
  px <- expand_grid(col = floor(x - r):ceiling(x + r), row = floor(y - r):ceiling(y + r)) %>%
    filter((col - x)^2 + (row - y)^2 <= r^2)
  255 - mean(grey[cbind(px$row, px$col)])
}

darkness_df <- darkness_samples %>%
  group_by(cryosection) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, key) {
    grey <- as.integer(magick::image_data(magick::image_read(original_image(key$cryosection)), "gray"))[, , 1]
    um_per_px <- coef(lm(Xcoord ~ pixel_x, d))[[2]]     # image scale: microscope µm per image pixel
    radius_px <- sqrt(d$size / pi) / um_per_px           # microsample radius in pixels
    mutate(d, darkness = pmap_dbl(list(pixel_x, pixel_y, radius_px), ~ spot_darkness(grey, ..1, ..2, ..3)))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

#### Microbial reads by darkness group
```{r s6_darkness_groups, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10}
to_pct <- function(x) 100 * (10^x - 1)   # log10 difference -> % difference
pct_label <- function(x) sprintf("%+.0f%%", x)

darkness_rel <- darkness_df %>%
  group_by(cryosection) %>%
  mutate(group     = factor(ntile(darkness, 4), 1:4, c("Lightest\n25%", "25-50%", "50-75%", "Darkest\n25%")),
         reads_rel = log10(reads) - mean(log10(reads))) %>%   # log10 difference from the section average
  ungroup()

# average per cryosection and group (small coloured points)
darkness_sections <- darkness_rel %>%
  group_by(cryosection, section, animal, group) %>%
  summarise(pct = to_pct(mean(reads_rel)), .groups = "drop")

# average over all cryosections per group (black dots), with 95% CI
darkness_groups <- darkness_rel %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(reads_rel), se = sd(reads_rel) / sqrt(n()), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(pct = to_pct(m), lo = to_pct(m - 1.96 * se), hi = to_pct(m + 1.96 * se))

darkest_vs_lightest <- to_pct(darkness_groups$m[4] - darkness_groups$m[1])
label_y <- max(darkness_sections$pct) + 8
section_dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.35)   # shift each cryosection sideways a little, the same in every group

fig_darkness_reads <- ggplot(darkness_sections, aes(group, pct)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(group = cryosection, colour = section, linetype = animal), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6,
            position = section_dodge) +
  geom_point(aes(group = cryosection, colour = section, shape = animal), size = 2, alpha = 0.8,
             position = section_dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(data = darkness_groups, aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = darkness_groups, size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = darkness_groups, aes(y = label_y, label = pct_label(pct)), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = label_y + 10, size = 3.5,
           label = sprintf("Darkest vs lightest: %s microbial reads", pct_label(darkest_vs_lightest))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = pct_label) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = section_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = animal_shapes, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = animal_lines, name = NULL) +
  guides(colour   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),
         shape    = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),
         linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = "grey30"))) +
  labs(x = "Microsamples grouped by darkness within their own cryosection",
       y = "Bacterial quantification reads compared with\nthe average of its section") +
  custom_ggplot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig_darkness_reads
```

#### Per cryosection
```{r s6_darkness_per_section, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
darkness_per_section <- darkness_df %>%
  group_by(cryosection) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, key) {
    f <- if (n_distinct(d$batch) > 1) log10(reads) ~ scale(darkness) + batch else log10(reads) ~ scale(darkness)
    fit <- coef(summary(lm(f, d)))["scale(darkness)", ]
    neighbours <- spdep::nb2listw(spdep::graph2nb(spdep::gabrielneigh(as.matrix(d[, c("Xcoord", "Ycoord")])), sym = TRUE))
    moran <- spdep::moran.test(d$darkness, neighbours)
    tibble(n                 = nrow(d),
           pct_reads_per_SD  = to_pct(fit[["Estimate"]]),
           moran_I_darkness  = moran$estimate[["Moran I statistic"]],
           p_moran           = moran$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

darkness_per_section %>%
  mutate(across(c(pct_reads_per_SD, moran_I_darkness), ~ round(.x, 2)),
         p_moran = signif(p_moran, 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable()

n_positive <- sum(darkness_per_section$pct_reads_per_SD > 0)
sign_test  <- binom.test(n_positive, nrow(darkness_per_section))
n_patchy   <- sum(darkness_per_section$p_moran < 0.05)

# share of the variation in reads explained by darkness within cryosections (all sections together)
R2_within <- darkness_df %>%
  group_by(cryosection) %>%
  mutate(reads_c = log10(reads) - mean(log10(reads)), darkness_c = darkness - mean(darkness)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(R2 = cor(reads_c, darkness_c)^2) %>%
  pull(R2)

# Summary
cat(sprintf("Darker spots had more reads in %d of %d cryosections (%.0f%% to %.0f%% more reads per SD darker; sign test p = %.2g).\n",
            n_positive, nrow(darkness_per_section),
            min(darkness_per_section$pct_reads_per_SD), max(darkness_per_section$pct_reads_per_SD), sign_test$p.value),
    sprintf("Darkness was spatially aggregated (Moran's I > 0, p < 0.05) in %d of %d cryosections (Moran's I %.2f - %.2f).\n",
            n_patchy, nrow(darkness_per_section),
            min(darkness_per_section$moran_I_darkness), max(darkness_per_section$moran_I_darkness)),
    sprintf("Within cryosections, darkness explained %.1f%% of the variation in log10 microbial reads.\n", 100 * R2_within),
    sep = "")
```
